analysis.title: Consistency analysis
analysis.intro: A Story Bible audit before you start writing: concept, characters, world and rules, plot threads, and overall consistency. The analysis receives every entity and every field, without shortening or omissions. Chapters, scenes and prose are handled by the Editor and Editing stages.
analysis.loadingDescription: Collecting concept, plot threads, characters and world into the analysis dossier.
analysis.dossierSize: Dossier: ~{{tokens}} tokens ({{chars}} characters). Context window of {{model}}: {{window}} tokens.
analysis.noTruncationNote: Every pass receives the complete dossier — no field or entity is shortened. Empty fields are passed explicitly so the model can see gaps in the project.
analysis.overflowWarning: The dossier does not fit into the selected model's context window. The analysis will still run and nothing will be truncated, but the model may reject the request — pick a 1M-window model (claude-opus-4-7 or gpt-4.1).
analysis.scopeHint: Each selected dimension is a separate pass. A synthesis pass at the end merges the findings into a single list.
analysis.scopeHintSingle: A single dimension — no synthesis. You get that pass's findings, ready to apply.
analysis.alreadyRunning: An analysis of this project is already running.
analysis.emptyDescription: Run an analysis to get a list of fixes in the AI panel on the right.
analysis.passSkippedHint: This dimension was outside the analysis scope.
analysis.outdatedHint: The dossier built now differs from the one the model worked on. Findings may be out of date.
analysis.panelWaiting: Waiting for a free slot in the AI queue.
analysis.applyTitleReady: Writes the proposed content into the target field.
analysis.applyTitleDisabled: This fix cannot be applied automatically.
analysis.patchStaleHint: The field changed after the analysis — run the analysis again so your own edits are not overwritten.
analysis.restoreFindingTitle: Undo the dismissal — the finding returns to the open list.
analysis.emptyApplied: No fix has been applied yet.
analysis.acceptReportTitle: Closes the analysis card in the AI panel and settles its passes. The report stays on the Analysis page.
analysis.acceptReportDone: Report accepted. You will find it on the Analysis page.
analysis.acceptReportError: Could not settle every analysis pass. Please try again.
